targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM security_events WHERE ts > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM syslog_events WHERE received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '1 hour'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM syslog_events WHERE threat_type IS NOT NULL AND received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM node_status WHERE status = 'up'

SELECT date_trunc('hour', ts) AS time, CASE WHEN rule_level >= 12 THEN 'Critical (12+)' WHEN rule_level >= 7 THEN 'High (7-11)' ELSE 'Low (0-6)' END AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM security_events WHERE $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('hour', received_at) AS time, CASE WHEN severity <= 3 THEN 'Error+Critical' WHEN severity <= 5 THEN 'Warning+Notice' ELSE 'Info' END AS metric, COUNT(*) AS value FROM syslog_events WHERE $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1
SELECT received_at AS time, hostname, threat_type, signature, action FROM syslog_events WHERE threat_type IS NOT NULL AND received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '24 hours' ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT hostname, COUNT(*) AS events, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE severity <= 3) AS errors FROM syslog_events WHERE received_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours' AND hostname IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY events DESC LIMIT 15

SELECT "timestamp" AS time, device_name || ' ' || metric_name AS metric, metric_value AS value FROM snmp_metrics WHERE metric_name IN ('ifInOctets', 'ifOutOctets') AND $__timeFilter("timestamp") ORDER BY 1
